mode: uniform appearance material reconstruction; not per-location texture recovery
method: exact reflected repetition; zero blur or RGB averaging
metal: existing center-strip meshes get independent metal material; no wood covering
limitations: repeated/mirrored grain is visible at close range
material roughness and metalness are artistic settings, not measured
remaining scene highlights/shadows come from renderer
mujoco_metal_note: specular approximation, not equivalent to USD metallic PBR
